entries.title: Show HN: Turn Your YouTube Subscriptions into a Retro TV Guide
entries.author: kilroy123
entries.current_title: Show HN: Channel Surfer – Watch YouTube like it’s cable TV
entries.excerpt: I know, it's a very first-world problem. But in my house, we have a hard time deciding what to watch. Too many options! So I made this to recreate Cable TV for YouTube. I made it so it runs in the browser. Quickly import your subscriptions in the browser via a bookmarklet. No accounts, no sign-ins. Just quickly import your data locally.
entries.guide_zh: 把 YouTube 订阅变成复古电视节目表，减少选择太多时的观看犹豫。

entries.title: Show HN: I built a sub-500ms latency voice agent from scratch
entries.author: nicktikhonov
entries.current_title: Show HN: I built a sub-500ms latency voice agent from scratch
entries.excerpt: I built a voice agent from scratch that averages ~400ms end-to-end latency (phone stop → first syllable). That’s with full STT → LLM → TTS in the loop, clean barge-ins, and no precomputed responses. What moved the needle: Voice is a turn-taking problem, not a transcription problem. VAD alone fails; you need semantic end-of-turn detection. The system reduces to one loop: speaking vs listening. The two transitions - cancel instantly on barge-in, respond instantly on end-of-turn
entries.guide_zh: 作者从零构建语音代理，报告完整语音识别到合成链路平均延迟约四百毫秒。

entries.author: rohan_joshi
entries.current_title: Show HN: Three new Kitten TTS models – smallest less than 25MB
entries.excerpt: Kitten TTS is an open-source series of tiny and expressive text-to-speech models for on-device applications. (We had a thread last year here: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=44807868 .) Today we're releasing three new models with 80M, 40M and 14M parameters. The largest model (80M) has the highest quality. The 14M variant reaches new SOTA in expressivity among similar sized models, despite being <25MB in size. entries.title: Show HN: Gemini can now natively embed video, so I built sub-second video search
entries.author: sohamrj
entries.current_title: Show HN: Gemini can now natively embed video, so I built sub-second video search
entries.excerpt: Gemini Embedding 2 can project raw video directly into a 768-dimensional vector space alongside text. No transcription, no frame captioning, no intermediate text. A query like "green car cutting me off" is directly comparable to a 30-second video clip at the vector level. I used this to build a CLI that indexes hours of footage into ChromaDB, then searches it with natural language and auto-trims the matching clip. Demo video on the GitHub README. entries.guide_zh: 利用 Gemini 原生视频嵌入做视频搜索，作者报告亚秒级查询体验。
